metadata.description: Repository knowledge for coding agents: every repository of an account, what it is and what each of its files is for, described in plain files an agent reads without cloning anything.

plugins.name: repomap
plugins.description: Answers questions about a set of repositories without searching them: which repository owns a thing, what it is built with, which file to open, what an account even holds. Works from an index kept as plain files - committed with a project, private to a machine, or published for a team - and can build, refresh and fetch that index, and say when it has gone out of date.
